name: Woolnorth Studland Bay / Bluff Point
current_developer: Woolnorth Wind Farm Finance Pty Ltd
notable: 138 MW across Studland Bay (75 MW) and Bluff Point (65 MW) wind farms at Woolnorth in NW Tasmania. Among the earliest large-scale wind farms in Tasmania, on one of the world's windiest coastlines. Operated by Hydro Tasmania.

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

eis_specs.document_title: Woolnorth Studland Bay Bluff Point — other source (v3.31.0 wind tranche 2)
eis_specs.turbine_model: Vestas V66-1.75 MW (Bluff Point) + Vestas V90-3.0 MW (Studland Bay)
eis_specs.connection_substation_name: Smithton 110 kV / North-West Coast Tas network
eis_specs.notes: Regime: other. Approved by Circular Head Council under Tas Land Use Planning and Approvals Act 1993. Bluff Point (65 MW) = 37 x Vestas V66-1.75 MW, hub 60 m, commissioned 2002 (Stage 1) & 2004 (Stage 2). Studland Bay (75 MW) = 25 x Vestas V90-3.0 MW, hub 80 m, commissioned 2007. Owned by Woolnorth Renewables (Shenhua/Guohua Energy). Repowering EIA now in progress with EPA Tasmania.
